name: ChatterForms
author: greycellz

sections.description:
ChatterForms is a hosted form builder with a free WordPress plugin for embedding forms using a Gutenberg block or shortcode. Create intake forms, consent forms, registrations, and service requests, then manage submissions in ChatterForms.

HIPAA-enabled publishing and Business Associate Agreement (BAA) signing are available on Pro. Pro costs $39.99 USD/month billed monthly, or $31.99 USD/month billed annually. Before collecting protected health information (PHI), complete the BAA, confirm your Pro subscription, and enable HIPAA on each applicable form. Installing this plugin does not, by itself, make your WordPress site HIPAA compliant.

Pricing and Plan Limits

The WordPress plugin is free. A ChatterForms account is required; a free service plan is available. All prices below are in USD. Annual prices are monthly equivalents billed annually, not month-to-month rates.

  • Free – $0. Includes 25 active forms and 100 submissions per month. HIPAA publishing and a BAA are not included.
  • Basic – $19.99/month billed monthly, or $15.99/month billed annually. Includes 100 active forms and 10,000 submissions per month. Adds custom branding, e-signature capture, Stripe payments, and Calendly scheduling. HIPAA publishing and a BAA are not included.
  • Pro – $39.99/month billed monthly, or $31.99/month billed annually. Includes unlimited active forms and 25,000 submissions per month. Includes Basic features, HIPAA-enabled publishing, and BAA signing with the setup described below.

Form limits refer to active forms. Unlimited active forms on Pro does not mean unlimited submissions. For current plans and custom requirements, see ChatterForms pricing or contact sales@chatterforms.com.

HIPAA-Enabled Forms and Business Associate Agreement

Does ChatterForms support HIPAA-covered workflows?

ChatterForms supports HIPAA-covered form workflows on Pro when configured for that use. A BAA and HIPAA features support your organization’s compliance obligations; they do not replace your own policies, access controls, consent requirements, or compliance review. Free and Basic do not include HIPAA publishing or a BAA.

How do I sign the BAA?

  1. Sign in to ChatterForms and select Pro from the pricing page.
  2. If you have not already signed a BAA, open the agreement for review in the Business Associate Agreement dialog.
  3. Review your signature preview, optionally enter your company name, and select Sign & Continue.
  4. Complete the subscription checkout. Once your subscription is confirmed and the agreement is processed, the completed BAA is emailed to you and available from your ChatterForms Billing page.
  5. Confirm that your completed agreement is available and enable HIPAA on each applicable form before collecting PHI. If the agreement is not available, contact support before collecting PHI.

Is HIPAA enabled automatically?

No. Signing the BAA and enabling HIPAA on a form are separate steps. Review and publish each applicable form with HIPAA enabled before sharing it with patients or embedding it on WordPress. A generated draft or a free preview is not authorization to collect PHI.

What is encrypted?

HIPAA form data is encrypted in transit over HTTPS and encrypted at rest in cloud storage, including stored signatures and generated PDFs. This is server-side protection, not end-to-end encryption. Do not assume every integration or item of metadata has the same protection as a HIPAA submission payload. See security information and contact support about your specific requirements.

Is there an audit trail?

ChatterForms has operational security logging, including logging of unauthorized access attempts. A dedicated self-service audit-log console is not currently available. Do not assume a downloadable, comprehensive compliance audit trail or a particular retention period; contact support to confirm whether the available records meet your requirements.

Where are submissions stored?

The plugin embeds a ChatterForms-hosted form in an iframe. This plugin does not store form submissions in the WordPress database. Submissions are handled by the hosted ChatterForms service. Your WordPress hosting, other plugins, analytics, and third-party integrations remain part of your own security and compliance review.

Does AI receive patient information?

AI is used to construct the form structure, such as questions, field types, and layout, not to process patient responses submitted through HIPAA-enabled forms. Those patient responses are not sent to AI models. Only non-patient form-building content should be provided to AI: do not put PHI into generation prompts, PDFs, images, or URLs used to build a form. Use blank forms or synthetic examples.

Can I connect HIPAA forms to other services?

HIPAA forms cannot use Zapier or outbound submission webhooks, and Slack is not a destination for HIPAA submissions. HIPAA submission notification emails are notices only and do not include PHI.

Pricing and HIPAA/BAA workflow information last checked against the application configuration and implementation: November 4, 2026. This is an editorial source-review date, not a HIPAA certification or an independent security-audit date.

Key Features

  • WordPress embedding – Use a Gutenberg block or shortcode to display a hosted form.
  • AI form builder – Create a draft from a text description, then review and customize it.
  • PDF and URL conversion – Start from a blank form document or a supported public form URL.
  • Conditional inputs – Show or hide fields based on responses.
  • E-signatures – Capture signatures on Basic and Pro.
  • Stripe payments – Collect payments on Basic and Pro with no ChatterForms platform fee; Stripe processing fees apply.
  • Calendly scheduling – Add a Calendly scheduling field on Basic and Pro.
  • Form analytics – View submission trends and insights in the ChatterForms dashboard.
  • Email notifications – Configure submission notifications with a verified owner email; HIPAA notices do not include PHI.
  • Responsive embeds – Display forms on desktop, tablet, and mobile, with optional automatic height adjustment.
  • HIPAA-enabled publishing – Available on Pro after BAA completion and form-level HIPAA setup.

How It Works

  1. Create a ChatterForms account.
  2. Build and review your form in ChatterForms. For HIPAA-covered use, complete the Pro and BAA setup described above.
  3. Publish the form with the appropriate settings, including HIPAA when required.
  4. Copy the form ID and embed it using the WordPress block or shortcode.
  5. Manage submissions in your ChatterForms dashboard.

Resources

  • Pricing and plans
  • HIPAA-enabled workflows
  • Security information
  • Terms of service
  • Privacy policy
  • E-signatures
  • Help and documentation
  • Setup video

Development

The Gutenberg block editor script in blocks/chatterform/build/index.js is generated. The human-readable source ships in this plugin.

  • Unminified source: blocks/chatterform/index.js
  • Styles: blocks/chatterform/style.css
  • Build tool: @wordpress/scripts. From this plugin directory, run npm install, then npm run build. Output is written to blocks/chatterform/build/.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “ChatterForms”.
  4. Select Install Now, then Activate.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the ZIP file and select Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.

Setup

  1. Create an account at ChatterForms.
  2. Build and publish your form. Before collecting PHI, complete the BAA, confirm Pro, and enable HIPAA on the form.
  3. Copy your form ID, such as form_1772500329046_medsz2ix1.
  4. Embed the published form using either method below.

Method 1: Gutenberg Block

  1. Edit a page or post.
  2. Add a block and search for “ChatterForms”.
  3. Paste the form ID or a ChatterForms URL containing /forms/form_....
  4. Configure the height and width settings.
  5. Publish the WordPress page and check the embed.

Method 2: Shortcode

[chatterform id="form_1772500329046_medsz2ix1" height="auto" width="100%"]

Publishing the WordPress page does not enable HIPAA on the hosted form. Configure that setting in ChatterForms first.
sections.faq:
Is the plugin free, and do I need an account?

The WordPress plugin is free. You need a ChatterForms account to create and manage forms. The service has Free, Basic, and Pro plans; see “Pricing and Plan Limits” above for prices and quotas or view current pricing.

Which plan includes HIPAA publishing and a BAA?

Pro includes HIPAA-enabled publishing and BAA signing. Free and Basic do not. Complete the BAA and enable HIPAA on each applicable form before collecting PHI. Installing the WordPress plugin alone does not establish HIPAA compliance for your site.

How do I sign and download my BAA?

Review and sign the agreement during the Pro upgrade flow using Sign & Continue, then complete checkout. After subscription confirmation and processing, the completed BAA is emailed and available from Billing. Confirm it is available before collecting PHI.

Is HIPAA enabled on every form automatically?

No. Enable HIPAA separately on each applicable form in ChatterForms before publishing it for PHI collection. A BAA signature alone does not enable HIPAA on all your forms.

Does the plugin store patient responses in WordPress?

No. The plugin displays a hosted ChatterForms form in an iframe and does not store submissions in the WordPress database. Review your hosting, other plugins, analytics, and integrations separately.

Are patient responses sent to AI?

No. Patient responses submitted through HIPAA-enabled forms are not sent to AI models. AI is used to construct the form structure, not to process those responses. Do not include patient information in form-generation prompts or source documents; use blank forms or synthetic examples.

Are forms and submissions unlimited?

No. Free includes 25 active forms and 100 submissions per month. Basic includes 100 active forms and 10,000 submissions per month. Pro includes unlimited active forms and 25,000 submissions per month. Unlimited active forms does not mean unlimited submissions.

Can I accept payments?

Basic and Pro support Stripe payment fields. ChatterForms does not charge a platform fee on payments; Stripe processing fees apply. Configure your Stripe connection before collecting payments.

Does this work with e-signatures?

Basic and Pro support e-signature capture for consent forms and agreements. You are responsible for reviewing whether your form and signing process meet your legal requirements.

Can I schedule appointments?

Basic and Pro support Calendly scheduling fields. Configure the field with your Calendly scheduling link. Scheduling is provided through Calendly rather than a separate WordPress booking system supplied by this plugin.

Will forms work on mobile?

The embedded forms are responsive. Test your form in your WordPress theme on desktop and mobile. Use height="auto" when you want the iframe height to adjust to its content.

Can I customize the form appearance?

Customize the hosted form in ChatterForms. Basic and Pro include custom branding. The WordPress block and shortcode control the embed dimensions.

How do I control the form width?

Use the block width setting or a shortcode width such as 100%, 75%, or 50%.

Example: [chatterform id="form_1772500329046_medsz2ix1" width="75%"]

What analytics are available?

View form analytics and submission trends in ChatterForms. The plugin does not add a separate WordPress analytics dashboard or a self-service compliance audit-log console.

Can I use conditional inputs?

Yes. Configure conditional inputs in the ChatterForms builder to show or hide fields based on responses.

What if I need help?

  • Documentation: ChatterForms help
  • Service support: support@chatterforms.com
  • WordPress plugin support: Use this plugin’s support forum on WordPress.org.
